Mori

Villa in Bang Jo
HomeSaleMori

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A village-style collection of two-storey modern pool villas in the Si Sunthon / Bang Jo area. The 3BR plan has parking, living, dining and kitchen downstairs, with a master suite, two bedrooms and a multi-purpose room upstairs.

Mori: key facts

  • Mori is a pool villa in Bang Jo, Phuket.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 229–260.28 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Feb 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿16,310,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Boat Avenue Mall (3.5 km); Greenhouse Kindergarten Phuket (2.7 km); HEI Schools Phuket (4.5 km); HeadStart International School (Cherngtalay) (3.3 km).
